measures.id: Senior Citizen Services Millage Renewal Proposal
measures.title: Senior Citizen Services Millage Renewal Proposal
measures.summary: Would renew Shiawassee County's senior citizen services property tax at up to 0.4942 mill ($0.4942 per $1,000 of taxable value), the rolled-back rate of a previously voted 0.5 mill, for five years, 2026 through 2030. The money funds senior citizen services in Shiawassee County. The first-year levy is estimated to raise $1,370,677, and part of it may go to local downtown development and brownfield authorities as required by law.
measures.yesMeans: Shiawassee County could continue levying up to 0.4942 mill for senior citizen services for 2026 through 2030.
measures.noMeans: The senior citizen services millage would not be renewed.

measures.title: An Amendment To The City Of Corunna Charter Such That The City Of Corunna Shall Be Elected At-Large Rather Than By Separate Wards As Terms Expire
measures.summary: Would amend Section 4.2 of the Corunna City Charter so that, instead of electing one council member from each ward to a four-year term at each regular city election, the city elects three council members to four-year terms without ward residency requirements. The change takes effect as current terms expire.
measures.yesMeans: Corunna City Council members would be elected at large instead of by ward as terms expire.
measures.noMeans: Corunna City Council members would continue to be elected by ward.

measures.title: An Amendment To The City Of Corunna Charter Such That The City Of Corunna Council Shall Have A Quorum Based On The Majority Of Seats Filled Rather Than Four (4) Members Of Council
measures.summary: Would amend Section 5.2(d) of the Corunna City Charter. A quorum of the city council would be a majority of the council members then holding office, instead of a fixed four members.
measures.yesMeans: A Corunna City Council quorum would be a majority of the members then in office.
measures.noMeans: A Corunna City Council quorum would remain four members.

measures.title: Gender Neutral Ballot Language
measures.summary: Would amend Chapters III through IX of the City of Corunna Charter to replace gender-specific terms with gender-neutral terms. The stated purpose is to make clear that the charter applies equally to all persons regardless of gender.
measures.yesMeans: The Corunna City Charter would be changed to use gender-neutral terms.
measures.noMeans: The Corunna City Charter's current wording would stay as it is.
